verdicts.reason: A: the right-hand cluster is overstuffed. The FREE DELIVERY badge collides with the tiny product image, the CTA is a speck no bigger than the pills, the body copy can't be read at 320x50, and the circle backdrop is gone. Still, it reads in order: GROVE, headline, product, action. B has the same overstuffed cluster with the same badge/product collision and unreadable body copy. It is worse because the headline is jammed against the left canvas edge with no margin and the GROVE wordmark is pushed mid-banner after the headline, which breaks the brand-first reading order.
